verdict.one_line: Class semantics, scope separation and falsifier structure survive independent reading, but the f0_binding fails its own hash chain at consistency_evidence_sha256 (declared 675a99d0... does not resolve at the named path; canonical bytes and FROZEN rev28 both measure 9e335e9b...), so this artifact cannot be accepted at this pin. Post-window update: the canonical path was rewritten to d9cebb94 at 00:53:40 with no publishing event and no FROZEN re-pin, so this verdict is bound to cce9c601 and the new bytes require their own review (F-085-07).

Quantifiers, genericity, C2/C0 separation and the whole f0_binding hash chain are sound at the live rev29 bytes, but the extension_predicate is under-frozen relative to its C0 sibling: the manifold category of M', the regularity of the embedding iota and the interior-future requirement of clause (f) are left to convention, so the exact extension class the C2 conclusion quantifies over is reader-dependent.
